candidates.change_summary: Change the return statement from returning true to returning false.
Change the return statement to return the result of the loop condition, yielding false for any nonempty call.
Delete the `require(_tos.length > 0);` check so an empty _tos array no longer reverts.
Delete the `require(_s);` check so failed transferFrom calls no longer revert.
Replace v[i] with v[0] in the transferFrom call so every recipient receives the first amount.
Change the loop bound to _tos.length - 1 so the last recipient's transfer is skipped.
Replace `from` with `address(this)` as the source of the transferFrom call.
